mapper.select: SELECT * FROM zentide_change WHERE status='PUBLISHED' AND verification_status='VERIFIED' ORDER BY COALESCE(occurred_at,created_at) DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT * FROM zentide_change WHERE change_id=#{changeId} AND status='PUBLISHED' AND verification_status='VERIFIED' LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM zentide_claim WHERE change_id=#{changeId} ORDER BY claim_id
SELECT e.* FROM zentide_evidence e WHERE e.change_id=#{changeId} ORDER BY e.evidence_id
